description: A Geospatial Dataset of Urban Infrastructure for Emergency Response in Portugal is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors João Paulo Just Peixoto. This dataset contains data about the number of response centres (hospitals, fire stations, police offices and railway stations) in every city in Portugal. Coverage: national (PT); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
